name: Flipper Cloudless Feature Flags
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted Ruby feature flags with local persistent adapters, actor/group/percentage rollouts and optional basic flipper-ui administration; no cloud subscription or vendor request quota.
watch_out: Designed for Ruby/Rails applications; requires your own application and datastore. Advanced hosted collaboration, audit history, permissions and polished Flipper Pro UI are not part of Cloudless.
